Principled Intelligence Builds Trust on MongoDB The Challenge Deploying unreliable or noncompliant AI systems risks reputational damage and regulatory trouble long before problems reach customers. Our Solution Principled Intelligence launched on MongoDB Atlas, using MongoDB Compass and Voyage AI to power its AI testing and governance platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores the operational data and provides the managed document database foundation for Principled Intelligence's workload.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Compass
solution_components.role: Helps engineers inspect data, troubleshoot issues, and speed debugging on live datasets.

solution_components.name: Voyage AI
solution_components.role: Provides semantic embedding capabilities for retrieval and AI evaluation workloads.

data_flow: Documents, logs, or product records are stored in MongoDB Atlas, and queried by Principled Intelligence's application workflows to return relevant results in real time.
business_outcome: Principled Intelligence's Spectral has run over 10,000 AI stress tests in a week, giving customers a full audit trail as usage scales.
metrics: Scaling to 10,000 Stress Tests Seamlessly Still in private beta, Principled Intelligence’s Spectral platform has already run over 10,000 adversarial conversations in a single week through its pilot programs — stress-testing enterprise AI systems to expose where these systems break down before customers' own end users do.
architecture_clues: The deployment uses a multi-cloud strategy.
Vector search is part of the retrieval layer for AI and semantic search workloads.
APIs are a key integration layer in the application architecture.
Managed backups and recovery capabilities are part of the production design.
The deployment integrates with Voyage AI.
